description: Rich reply blocks for readable output: a choice, a form, a procedure in steps, a callout or a Mermaid diagram written as a fenced block inside an ordinary Markdown reply, rendered by the Web App with its own components and shown as plain text everywhere else; a pick fills the composer as ordinary text. Comes with STE-style writing rules for Chinese and English and a checker script that validates every block, scores the draft and prints a self-review rubric before the reply is sent.
description_zh: 让模型输出更易读的富文本组件：选项、表单、分步操作、提示框和 Mermaid 图，以围栏代码块的形式写在普通 Markdown 回复里，Web App 用自己的组件渲染，其他界面显示为纯文本；用户的选择以普通文字填入输入框。附带中英文的 STE 风格写作规则，以及一个检查脚本：发送前校验每个组件、给草稿打分并打印自审清单。
short_description: Choices, forms, steps, callouts and diagrams in replies, with a checker.
short_description_zh: 在回复里使用选项、表单、步骤、提示框和图表，并自带检查脚本。

quick_start.prompt: Ask me which of three weekend plans I prefer as a choice block, then show the one I pick as a short procedure in steps.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 用选项组件问我三个周末计划中更喜欢哪一个，再把我选中的那个写成一份简短的分步操作。
